items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: The name 'George' appears only in the interviewer's turn as an idiomatic expression ('by George') and is not a person the interviewee interacts with or knows.

ctx.x: Well, this was a group that studied the Noon records to reproduce the Noon. And then, of course, they did a lot of other tunes, but they thought that if they started off with Apex Blues performed in the Noon manner, that they'd be able to build up. And by George, they were imitative to a very agreeable degree. So, Noon, with his orchestra as well as with his solo clarinet, lived on some... ... ...

Some of them on record, whether or not they have a continuing influence is a matter that's considerably problematic to you. You don't know whether they might or whether they actually do. Let's take some of the people in the first generation, and let's see if you remember specifically that they could have influenced some of the Chicago boys. Was Bechet to any extent imitated?
